_about: The CMA metric catalog: one entry per figure the Workspace shows (every tile, count, column, bar and exported column, on every page and in the JSON API), described as the code computes it. Hand-maintained in the PR that adds or changes a figure; validated against schema.json by web/verify/metrics.mjs, which also fails the build for a figure without an entry (the registry in web/src/lib/metrics.ts). METRICS.md and web/src/lib/metrics-catalog.json are generated from this file by web/scripts/metrics-doc.mjs, never edited. Audit findings live in AUDIT-2026-10-23.md; nothing in this catalog changes a formula.

entries.definition: How long the person has worked today: time in working statuses only, pauses excluded, up to now (or up to the day's window end).
entries.formula: workedSeconds = clock.closedSeconds + (now - runningSince when the current status is working), where now is capped at dayEndsAt (the window end); minutes = floor(seconds/60), shown as Xh YYm. closedSeconds = sum of closed or capped interval seconds where status.is_working; runningSince = start of the open, non-capped interval while its status is working (readDay, postgres.ts:77-102).

entries.definition: The badge next to today's shift comparing the plan with the actual clock, with the tenant's tolerance: Late (clocked in after the planned start plus tolerance), Left early (clocked out before the planned end minus tolerance), Expected (the start has passed, nobody clocked in), Absent (an absence planned, not on the clock), Not planned (on the clock without a planned shift). On time is computed but never shown as a badge.
entries.formula: adherence(planned, actual, date, person zone, nowMs, tol): no plan -> startedAt ? unplanned : null; plan is absence -> startedAt ? unplanned : absent; no actual start -> now > plannedStart + tol*60000 ? expected : null; endedAt < plannedEnd - tol -> leftEarly; startedAt > plannedStart + tol -> late; else onTime. plannedInstant resolves the local hh:mm on the date in the person's zone (earlier instant on the repeated autumn hour; 24:00 = next day 00:00). nowMs is the server render's clock, refreshed every 10 s.

  select d.id, d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.source_created_at, coalesce(d.is_closed, false) as is_closed, rm.code as market,
         array(select x from (select d.contact_source_id as x where d.contact_source_id is not null
                              union
                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, d.connection_id, d.market, d.contact_source_id) rm
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)),
fo as (
  select d.id as deal_id, min(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) as fo_at
  from d cross join s
  join cma.crm_call c on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                  and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                  and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)
                       or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts))))
  group by d.id),
m as (
  select d.*, fo.fo_at, s.target_s,
         case when fo.fo_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, fo.fo_at) end as bs,
         case when fo.fo_at is null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) end as bs_now
  from d cross join s left join fo on fo.deal_id = d.id)
select round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.bs))::numeric / 60, 1) as median_business_minutes,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end), 0), 1) as within_target_pct,
       count(*) filter (where m.fo_at is null and not m.is_closed) as open_not_called
from m

with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'tasks.callback_window_minutes')::integer) as win
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
b as (select (:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone as from_at, ((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone as to_at from s),
k as (
  select k.connection_id, k.source_id, k.contact_source_id, k.due_at
  from cma.crm_task k
  join cma.connection_task_type y
    on y.tenant_id = :tenant_id and y.connection_id = k.connection_id and y.type_ref = k.type_ref
   and y.is_callback and y.is_counted
  cross join b
  where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.source_deleted_at is null
    and k.due_at is not null and k.contact_source_id is not null
    and k.due_at >= b.from_at and k.due_at < b.to_at),
c as (
  select k.*,
         (select min(coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at))
          from cma.crm_association a
          join cma.crm_call cl
            on cl.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and cl.connection_id = a.connection_id and cl.source_id = a.from_id
           and cl.source_deleted_at is null
          left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = cl.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cl.id and l.unlinked_at is null
          left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = k.connection_id
            and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.to_type = 'contact'
            and a.to_id = k.contact_source_id and a.removed_at is null
            and coalesce(tc.started_at, cl.occurred_at) between k.due_at - s.win and k.due_at + s.win) as call_at
  from k cross join s)
select count(*) filter (where call_at is not null) as kept,
       count(*) filter (where call_at is null and due_at + s.win <= now()) as not_kept,
       count(*) filter (where call_at is null and due_at + s.win > now()) as pending,
       round((count(*) filter (where call_at is not null))::numeric
             / nullif(count(*) filter (where call_at is not null or due_at + s.win <= now()), 0), 4) as kept_share
from c cross join s
entries.notes: The Follow-up page's callbacks figures (per week, per person, no_contact/no_due rows) are agent follow-up's entries (follow_up.callbacks.*); this tile is only keptShare of the period total. Tasks without a due time are windowed on their creation for the DATE but can never be kept (state no_due, counted apart). Verify query mirrors db/88:75-142 with business_date filtering folded into the due_at window (equivalent: business_date = due/creation instant in tenant zone, and the from/to instants are those dates' bounds); the simplification drops the no_due branch, which the tile does not show. NOT clamped at intake.start_date (the reporting view cma_read.callbacks_kept is; the app read is period-only) - noted under the start-date-note finding. getCallbacksKept also fetches 'previous' but the tile shows no delta.

entries.definition: How many new lead deals were created in the period, per group (day, market, agent or pipeline).
entries.formula: deals = count(*) over cma.speed_to_lead_of rows of the group: deals of counted lead pipelines, not deleted, created on or after intake.start_date and inside the period (business dates, tenant zone). Grouping: day = business_date; market = resolved market ('unknown' when neither the deal's mapped market nor the primary contact's country names a catalog market); agent = mapped person of the first outbound call's owner, else the deal's owner, key 'unknown' when unmapped; pipeline = connection_id:pipeline_id labelled by the pipeline's label.

with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date,
         greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
         cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.target_minutes')::integer * 60 as target_s
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.id, d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.source_created_at, coalesce(d.is_closed, false) as is_closed,
         rm.code as market, (d.source_created_at at time zone s.zone)::date as business_date,
         array(select x from (select d.contact_source_id as x where d.contact_source_id is not null
                              union
                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d
  cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, d.connection_id, d.market, d.contact_source_id) rm
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)),
fo as (
  select d.id as deal_id, min(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) as fo_at
  from d cross join s
  join cma.crm_call c
    on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                  and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                  and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)
                       or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts))))
  group by d.id),
m as (
  select d.*, fo.fo_at, s.target_s,
         case when fo.fo_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, fo.fo_at) end as bs,
         case when fo.fo_at is null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) end as bs_now,
         cma.next_business_noon_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at) as noon
  from d cross join s left join fo on fo.deal_id = d.id)
select m.business_date,
       count(*) as deals,
       count(m.fo_at) as called,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.bs))::numeric / 60, 1) as median_business_minutes,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end), 0), 1) as within_target_pct,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end), 0), 1) as before_next_noon_pct,
       count(*) filter (where m.fo_at is null and not m.is_closed) as open_not_called
from m group by m.business_date order by m.business_date

deals only (record_type = 'deal'), not deleted (source_deleted_at is null)

counted lead pipelines only: coalesce(connection_pipeline.is_counted, true) and coalesce(is_lead, true) - a pipeline not yet reviewed counts and is a lead pipeline (data-quality check pipeline_unreviewed); Sales Pipeline - Self Serve is un-leaded in prod (Decision log 12 Oct 2026)
created on or after intake.start_date (tenant zone) and inside [:from, :to] as business dates in the tenant zone

first call: CRM calls of the deal's connection, not deleted, currently associated with the deal or one of its contacts (primary contact plus current deal->contact associations), effective start (linked telephony call's started_at while the link is current and the call not deleted, else crm_call.occurred_at) >= created_at - speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes
test deals: no filter - 'No test deals in the live pipeline' is a data prerequisite (kpis.md paragraph 11), not code; the only lever is the pipeline counted/lead switches
entries.time: Business date = the deal's source_created_at in the tenant's zone (cma.report_range); business minutes counted in the deal's market's office hours (cma.business_hours of the market, else '*', holidays of the market and '*' excluded, each day placed in the market's zone); now = the query's now(); a running period simply ends at :to (no cut to time of day); max 92 days (CMA04)
entries.definition: The typical wait from a lead deal's creation to its first outbound call, in office minutes of the deal's market: half of the called deals were called faster.
entries.formula: median = round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by business_seconds)::numeric / 60, 1); business_seconds = cma.business_seconds_of(market, created_at, first_outbound_at), computed only for called deals, null for market 'unknown' (SQL aggregates skip nulls), 0 when the call predates creation (pre-window). So the median runs over called deals with a known market only.
entries.verify_sql:
with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date,
         greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
         cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.target_minutes')::integer * 60 as target_s
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.id, d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.source_created_at, coalesce(d.is_closed, false) as is_closed,
         rm.code as market, (d.source_created_at at time zone s.zone)::date as business_date,
         array(select x from (select d.contact_source_id as x where d.contact_source_id is not null
                              union
                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d
  cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, d.connection_id, d.market, d.contact_source_id) rm
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)),
fo as (
  select d.id as deal_id, min(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) as fo_at
  from d cross join s
  join cma.crm_call c
    on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                  and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                  and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id)
                       or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any (d.contacts))))
  group by d.id),
m as (
  select d.*, fo.fo_at, s.target_s,
         case when fo.fo_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, fo.fo_at) end as bs,
         case when fo.fo_at is null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) end as bs_now,
         cma.next_business_noon_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at) as noon
  from d cross join s left join fo on fo.deal_id = d.id)
select m.business_date,
       count(*) as deals,
       count(m.fo_at) as called,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by m.bs))::numeric / 60, 1) as median_business_minutes,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end), 0), 1) as within_target_pct,
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end), 0), 1) as before_next_noon_pct,
       count(*) filter (where m.fo_at is null and not m.is_closed) as open_not_called
from m group by m.business_date order by m.business_date
entries.notes: True median (percentile_cont 0.5, audit rule 6), not an average: db/40:825. Business minutes use the market's own office hours, else the '*' schedule, holidays of the market and '*' excluded (db/40:119-153); a deal in market 'unknown' contributes nothing here and shows 'No business hours' in the open list. Display: fmtBusinessMinutes ('7,5 min' under an hour, '1h 05m' from one, dash for null). p80BusinessMinutes is still computed and returned by the API but not shown since 15 Oct 2026 (decisions.md; agent api-health owns api.speed_to_lead.p80_business_minutes). One query recomputes the whole day-grouped summary (cma.business_seconds_of, next_business_noon_of, record_market_of and setting_of are 0007d helpers, not the figure's own functions); compare the column this entry names. Swap the final GROUP BY for market/agent/pipeline to verify the other groupings.

entries.notes: db/40:469-472 (flag), :827 (share). Denominator verified against the label's claim ('deals whose outcome is known', copy.speedToLead.minutesNote) - matches. TWO drifts from the header hint (copy.hints.withinTarget: 'Deals closed without a call count as missed; deals still open and not called are left out until they are called or closed'): (1) a deal closed without a call stays null (left out) until wall-clock business time since creation passes the target, only then false; (2) an OPEN not-called deal past the target counts as false (missed), it is not left out. Code matches DESIGN 4.4 ('null while it could still make it, false once it cannot'); the hint matches neither. Also: the flag keeps being evaluated against now(), so a past period's percentage can still change as open/closed uncalled deals cross the target. See findings. fmtPct shows whole percents, '< 1%' for 0<pct<0.5.

with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date,
         greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
         cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'speed_to_lead.target_minutes')::integer * 60 as target_s
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.id, d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.source_created_at, coalesce(d.is_closed, false) as is_closed,
         rm.code as market, (d.source_created_at at time zone s.zone)::date as business_date,
         array(select x from (select d.contact_source_id as x where d.contact_source_id is not null
                              union
                              select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                              where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                                and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                                and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c) as contacts
  from cma.crm_record d
  cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, d.connection_id, d.market, d.contact_source_id) rm
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at >= ((:from)::date::timestamp at time zone s.zone)
    and d.source_created_at < (((:to)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone s.zone)),
fo as (
  select d.id as deal_id, min(coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at)) as fo_at
  from d cross join s
  join cma.crm_call c
    on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound'
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre_min)
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id
                  and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null

m as (
  select d.*, fo.fo_at, s.target_s,
         case when fo.fo_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, fo.fo_at) end as bs,
         case when fo.fo_at is null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(d.market, 'unknown'), d.source_created_at, now()) end as bs_now,

       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where case when m.bs is not null then m.bs <= m.target_s when m.bs_now > m.target_s then false end)

                                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end)
             / nullif(count(case when m.fo_at is not null and m.noon is not null then m.fo_at < m.noon
                                 when m.fo_at is null and m.noon is not null and now() >= m.noon then false end), 0), 1) as before_next_noon_pct,
       count(*) filter (where m.fo_at is null and not m.is_closed) as open_not_called
from m group by m.business_date order by m.business_date

entries.definition: The typical (median) time from the customer's first message to the first reply by an agent, in business minutes of the conversation's market: half of the replies were faster, half slower. Only conversations that got an agent reply count; a conversation whose market is unknown has no business hours and is counted apart.
entries.formula: Per opening: first_in = first incoming inbox message after the close the opening follows (any for a creation), up to the opening's own close; first_reply = first outgoing inbox message with actor_kind 'agent', status <> 'failed', strictly after first_in, up to that close. reply_business_seconds = cma.business_seconds_of(tenant, thread market, first_in, first_reply) — the market's own hours else the '*' schedule, holidays excluded; null for an unknown market. Median = percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by reply_business_seconds) over replied openings with business seconds known, rounded to 0.1 s; null without values (dash).

entries.notes: Tile value (fmtTalk of the business median; dash when null) with detail '{pct} within {target} business minutes', or 'No replies in this period' (replied = 0), or 'No business hours for {n} replies' (targetKnown = 0). Also 'First reply' column of all four tables. True median (percentile_cont 0.5), never an average. The elapsed median is returned too and shown as the per-inbox 'Elapsed' column (email.first_reply_median_elapsed). The figure is uncensored: openings never replied to are excluded, so a backlog of unanswered conversations does not worsen it — Replied and Opened beside it carry that. Openings are dated by opening time: a reply after the period's end still counts to this period. No delta on this tile (comparison null); the API returns the previous medians. verify_sql uses cma.business_seconds_of and cma.email_market_of as helpers: the page's 0008x function computes both inline, and 83/91 verify they agree, so this is the closest independent check.

entries.definition: The same median first reply in elapsed time, evenings and weekends included — shown beside the business median so a quiet weekend conversation is not hidden.
entries.formula: reply_seconds = extract(epoch from first_reply - first_in); median = percentile_cont(0.5) over ALL replied openings (business hours known or not), rounded to 0.1 s.

entries.definition: The share of first replies within the tenant's reply target, of the replies whose market has business hours.
entries.formula: within_target = count(replied openings where reply_business_seconds <= greatest(1, email.reply_target_minutes) * 60); target_known = count(replied openings where reply_business_seconds is not null); share = within_target / target_known, null (dash / 'No business hours for {n} replies') when target_known = 0. Replies of an unknown market (no business hours) are excluded from both sides and counted as No business hours.

entries.verify_sql: with s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre, t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as start from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), d as (select r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.contact_source_id, r.source_created_at from cma.crm_record r cross join s left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id and p.record_type = r.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(r.is_closed, false) and r.source_created_at >= (s.start::timestamp at time zone s.zone)) select count(*) from d cross join s where not exists (select 1 from cma.crm_call c left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = c.id and l.unlinked_at is null left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = l.tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.connection_id = d.connection_id and c.source_deleted_at is null and c.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(tc.started_at, c.occurred_at) >= d.source_created_at - make_interval(mins => s.pre) and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id and a.connection_id = c.connection_id and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = c.source_id and a.removed_at is null and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = d.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and (a.to_id = d.contact_source_id or a.to_id in (select a2.to_id from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = d.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = d.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null))))))

A call to a contact with two open deals counts for both deals

page filters, all applied to current AND previous alike: market (code or unknown), pipeline (connection:pipeline), attempted (all/none/some), outcome (all/open/won/lost/ordered); an invalid filter value is dropped with a notice (web) / 400 (API)

entries.time: Business date = the deal's creation in the tenant's zone (cma.tenant.timezone); week = date_trunc('week'), Monday. Business seconds/days use the deal's market's office hours and holidays (cma.business_seconds_of / cma.business_days_of; market 'unknown' has none). now = now() at read time; the attempt window of an open deal ends at now.
entries.comparison: Previous span like for like (cma.forms_previous_of): prev_from = from - len, prev_to = min(to, today) - len with len = to-from+1 days; while the period reaches today the previous span's last date is cut at now's time of day (the deal's local creation time <= until). DeltaLine shows 'No history to compare yet' when previousFrom < history_start = greatest(intake.start_date, business date of the tenant's first stored CRM call) (cma.attempts_history_start_of).

entries.verify_sql:
with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'attempts.source') as src,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cmin,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vmin,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d0 as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, r.stage_id,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as business_date,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null
          union
          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d0.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)
               or exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = od.connection_id
                          and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = od.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null
                          and a2.to_id = any(dk.contacts)))),
      (select min(co.source_created_at) from cma.crm_contact k
        join cma.crm_contact_ref cr on cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.contact_id = k.id
        join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.source_system = cr.system and co.customer_source_id = cr.external_id
        where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.connection_id = dk.connection_id and k.source_id = any(dk.contacts)
          and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
          and co.source_created_at >= dk.created_at and co.source_created_at <= now())) as ordered_at,
    st.outcome as stage_outcome, st.label as stage_label
  from dk

d0 as (

         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null

          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a

            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)

                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref

    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id

with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'attempts.source') as src,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cmin,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vmin,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d0 as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, r.stage_id,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as business_date,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null
          union
          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d0.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)
               or exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = od.connection_id
                          and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = od.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null
                          and a2.to_id = any(dk.contacts)))),
      (select min(co.source_created_at) from cma.crm_contact k
        join cma.crm_contact_ref cr on cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.contact_id = k.id
        join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.source_system = cr.system and co.customer_source_id = cr.external_id
        where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.connection_id = dk.connection_id and k.source_id = any(dk.contacts)
          and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
          and co.source_created_at >= dk.created_at and co.source_created_at <= now())) as ordered_at,
    st.outcome as stage_outcome, st.label as stage_label
  from dk
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = dk.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = dk.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = dk.stage_id),
w as (
  select w0.*, least(coalesce(w0.closed_end,'infinity'), coalesce(w0.ordered_at,'infinity'), now()) as window_end,
    case when w0.closed_end is not null and (w0.ordered_at is null or w0.closed_end <= w0.ordered_at) then 'closed'
         when w0.ordered_at is not null then 'ordered' else 'open' end as end_reason
  from w0),
wd as (
  select w.*, case when w.stage_outcome = 'won' then 'won' when w.end_reason = 'ordered' then 'ordered'
                   when w.stage_outcome = 'lost' then 'lost' when w.is_closed then 'unknown' else 'open' end as outcome
  from w),
ca as (
  select wd.deal_id, cc.id as call_id, coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) as eff_at,
         tc.started_at is not null as linked, cc.direction as cdir, tc.direction as tdir,
         coalesce(n.is_counted, true) as line_counted, cc.outcome_ref,
         tc.talk_seconds,
         coalesce(tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s)), false) as connected,
         co.label as outcome_label,
         case when (select src from s) = 'crm' then cc.direction = 'outbound'
              else tc.started_at is not null and tc.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) end as is_attempt,
         cc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.started_at is null as without_aircall,
         coalesce(((tc.direction = 'outbound' and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s))) or tc.direction = 'inbound')
                  and tc.answered_at is not null and tc.talk_seconds >= (select vmin from s), false)
           and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref
                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref
  left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = :tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) >= wd.created_at - make_interval(mins => (select pre_min from s))
    and coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) <= wd.window_end
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id
                and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = cc.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),
f as (
  select wd.*, a.attempts, a.conversations, a.first_conversation, a.talk_total, a.talk_conversation, a.first_at, a.last_at, a.no_outcome, a.without_aircall,
         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,
           (min(rn) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation))::int as first_conversation,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,
           min(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as first_at,
           max(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as last_at,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.outcome_ref is null)::int as no_outcome,
           count(*) filter (where ca.without_aircall)::int as without_aircall
    from (select ca.*, row_number() over (partition by ca.is_attempt order by ca.eff_at, ca.call_id) as rn
          from ca where ca.deal_id = wd.deal_id) ca(deal_id, call_id, eff_at, linked, cdir, tdir, line_counted, outcome_ref,
                                                    talk_seconds, connected, outcome_label, is_attempt, without_aircall, conversation, rn)
    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)
select round(avg(f.attempts)::numeric,2) as avg_attempts, round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by f.attempts))::numeric,1) as median_attempts, coalesce(sum(f.attempts),0) as attempts from f

entries.notes: True median (percentile_cont 0.5), not an average; the delta compares the average. The median includes 0-attempt deals, so it reads low while many deals are new.

title.en: Share of deals with a conversation

entries.definition: The share of the period's sales deals with at least one attempt that was a conversation; the detail names how many had it on the first attempt.
entries.formula: conversation_deals = count(deals with conversation_attempts > 0); share = conversation_deals / deals (null when 0). An attempt is a conversation when its linked telephony call is a Conversation (cma.is_conversation): connected (outbound and answered, at telephony.connected_min_seconds of talk when that is above 0), at least calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds of talk and no current tag meaning not reached or incorrect data; the CRM call's outcome decides nothing and a CRM call without a linked telephony call is never one. Connected alone is no conversation (voicemail answers too). first_conversation (detail) = count(deals whose first_conversation_attempt = 1).

       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = dk.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = dk.stage_id),
w as (
  select w0.*, least(coalesce(w0.closed_end,'infinity'), coalesce(w0.ordered_at,'infinity'), now()) as window_end,
    case when w0.closed_end is not null and (w0.ordered_at is null or w0.closed_end <= w0.ordered_at) then 'closed'
         when w0.ordered_at is not null then 'ordered' else 'open' end as end_reason
  from w0),
wd as (
  select w.*, case when w.stage_outcome = 'won' then 'won' when w.end_reason = 'ordered' then 'ordered'
                   when w.stage_outcome = 'lost' then 'lost' when w.is_closed then 'unknown' else 'open' end as outcome
  from w),
ca as (
  select wd.deal_id, cc.id as call_id, coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) as eff_at,
         tc.started_at is not null as linked, cc.direction as cdir, tc.direction as tdir,
         coalesce(n.is_counted, true) as line_counted, cc.outcome_ref,
         tc.talk_seconds,
         coalesce(tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s)), false) as connected,
         co.label as outcome_label,

         cc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.started_at is null as without_aircall,
         coalesce(((tc.direction = 'outbound' and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s))) or tc.direction = 'inbound')
                  and tc.answered_at is not null and tc.talk_seconds >= (select vmin from s), false)

                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref
  left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = :tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) >= wd.created_at - make_interval(mins => (select pre_min from s))
    and coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) <= wd.window_end
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id
                and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = cc.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),
f as (
  select wd.*, a.attempts, a.conversations, a.first_conversation, a.talk_total, a.talk_conversation, a.first_at, a.last_at, a.no_outcome, a.without_aircall,
         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,
           (min(rn) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation))::int as first_conversation,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,

          from ca where ca.deal_id = wd.deal_id) ca(deal_id, call_id, eff_at, linked, cdir, tdir, line_counted, outcome_ref,
                                                    talk_seconds, connected, outcome_label, is_attempt, without_aircall, conversation, rn)
    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)

entries.comparison: Previous span like for like (cma.forms_previous_of): prev_from = from - len, prev_to = min(to, today) - len with len = to-from+1 days; while the period reaches today the previous span's last date is cut at now's time of day (the deal's local creation time <= until). d0 as (

  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null

            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (

    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(

        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)

  from w),

                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref

                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),

         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,

           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,

    from (select ca.*, row_number() over (partition by ca.is_attempt order by ca.eff_at, ca.call_id) as rn

    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)

with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'attempts.source') as src,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cmin,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vmin,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d0 as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, r.stage_id,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as business_date,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null
          union
          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d0.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)
               or exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = od.connection_id
                          and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = od.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null
                          and a2.to_id = any(dk.contacts)))),
      (select min(co.source_created_at) from cma.crm_contact k
        join cma.crm_contact_ref cr on cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.contact_id = k.id
        join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.source_system = cr.system and co.customer_source_id = cr.external_id
        where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.connection_id = dk.connection_id and k.source_id = any(dk.contacts)
          and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
          and co.source_created_at >= dk.created_at and co.source_created_at <= now())) as ordered_at,
    st.outcome as stage_outcome, st.label as stage_label
  from dk
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = dk.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = dk.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = dk.stage_id),
w as (
  select w0.*, least(coalesce(w0.closed_end,'infinity'), coalesce(w0.ordered_at,'infinity'), now()) as window_end,
    case when w0.closed_end is not null and (w0.ordered_at is null or w0.closed_end <= w0.ordered_at) then 'closed'
         when w0.ordered_at is not null then 'ordered' else 'open' end as end_reason
  from w0),
wd as (
  select w.*, case when w.stage_outcome = 'won' then 'won' when w.end_reason = 'ordered' then 'ordered'
                   when w.stage_outcome = 'lost' then 'lost' when w.is_closed then 'unknown' else 'open' end as outcome
  from w),
ca as (
  select wd.deal_id, cc.id as call_id, coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) as eff_at,
         tc.started_at is not null as linked, cc.direction as cdir, tc.direction as tdir,
         coalesce(n.is_counted, true) as line_counted, cc.outcome_ref,
         tc.talk_seconds,
         coalesce(tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s)), false) as connected,
         co.label as outcome_label,
         case when (select src from s) = 'crm' then cc.direction = 'outbound'
              else tc.started_at is not null and tc.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) end as is_attempt,
         cc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.started_at is null as without_aircall,
         coalesce(((tc.direction = 'outbound' and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s))) or tc.direction = 'inbound')
                  and tc.answered_at is not null and tc.talk_seconds >= (select vmin from s), false)
           and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref
                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref
  left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = :tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) >= wd.created_at - make_interval(mins => (select pre_min from s))
    and coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) <= wd.window_end
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id
                and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = cc.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),
f as (
  select wd.*, a.attempts, a.conversations, a.first_conversation, a.talk_total, a.talk_conversation, a.first_at, a.last_at, a.no_outcome, a.without_aircall,
         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,
           (min(rn) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation))::int as first_conversation,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,
           min(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as first_at,
           max(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as last_at,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.outcome_ref is null)::int as no_outcome,
           count(*) filter (where ca.without_aircall)::int as without_aircall
    from (select ca.*, row_number() over (partition by ca.is_attempt order by ca.eff_at, ca.call_id) as rn
          from ca where ca.deal_id = wd.deal_id) ca(deal_id, call_id, eff_at, linked, cdir, tdir, line_counted, outcome_ref,
                                                    talk_seconds, connected, outcome_label, is_attempt, without_aircall, conversation, rn)
    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)
select count(*) filter (where f.outcome = 'open' and f.attempts = 0) as open_never_attempted, count(*) filter (where f.outcome = 'open') as open_deals from f

entries.notes: Covers HubSpot's 'Open deals not contacted recently' together with the since-last buckets (CMA-042 port). with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'attempts.source') as src,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cmin,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vmin,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d0 as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, r.stage_id,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as business_date,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null
          union
          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d0.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)
               or exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = od.connection_id
                          and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = od.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null
                          and a2.to_id = any(dk.contacts)))),
      (select min(co.source_created_at) from cma.crm_contact k
        join cma.crm_contact_ref cr on cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.contact_id = k.id
        join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.source_system = cr.system and co.customer_source_id = cr.external_id
        where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.connection_id = dk.connection_id and k.source_id = any(dk.contacts)
          and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
          and co.source_created_at >= dk.created_at and co.source_created_at <= now())) as ordered_at,
    st.outcome as stage_outcome, st.label as stage_label
  from dk
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = dk.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = dk.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = dk.stage_id),
w as (
  select w0.*, least(coalesce(w0.closed_end,'infinity'), coalesce(w0.ordered_at,'infinity'), now()) as window_end,
    case when w0.closed_end is not null and (w0.ordered_at is null or w0.closed_end <= w0.ordered_at) then 'closed'
         when w0.ordered_at is not null then 'ordered' else 'open' end as end_reason
  from w0),
wd as (
  select w.*, case when w.stage_outcome = 'won' then 'won' when w.end_reason = 'ordered' then 'ordered'
                   when w.stage_outcome = 'lost' then 'lost' when w.is_closed then 'unknown' else 'open' end as outcome
  from w),
ca as (
  select wd.deal_id, cc.id as call_id, coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) as eff_at,
         tc.started_at is not null as linked, cc.direction as cdir, tc.direction as tdir,
         coalesce(n.is_counted, true) as line_counted, cc.outcome_ref,
         tc.talk_seconds,
         coalesce(tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s)), false) as connected,
         co.label as outcome_label,
         case when (select src from s) = 'crm' then cc.direction = 'outbound'
              else tc.started_at is not null and tc.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) end as is_attempt,
         cc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.started_at is null as without_aircall,
         coalesce(((tc.direction = 'outbound' and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s))) or tc.direction = 'inbound')
                  and tc.answered_at is not null and tc.talk_seconds >= (select vmin from s), false)
           and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref
                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref
  left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = :tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) >= wd.created_at - make_interval(mins => (select pre_min from s))
    and coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) <= wd.window_end
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id
                and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = cc.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),
f as (
  select wd.*, a.attempts, a.conversations, a.first_conversation, a.talk_total, a.talk_conversation, a.first_at, a.last_at, a.no_outcome, a.without_aircall,
         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,
           (min(rn) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation))::int as first_conversation,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,
           min(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as first_at,
           max(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as last_at,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.outcome_ref is null)::int as no_outcome,
           count(*) filter (where ca.without_aircall)::int as without_aircall
    from (select ca.*, row_number() over (partition by ca.is_attempt order by ca.eff_at, ca.call_id) as rn
          from ca where ca.deal_id = wd.deal_id) ca(deal_id, call_id, eff_at, linked, cdir, tdir, line_counted, outcome_ref,
                                                    talk_seconds, connected, outcome_label, is_attempt, without_aircall, conversation, rn)
    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)
select f.outcome, count(*) as deals from f where f.outcome in ('won','lost') group by f.outcome

           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,

filters: tenant: SECURITY INVOKER functions under RLS on tenant_id plus cma.current_tenant_id(); the _of functions take the tenant explicitly

population: deals of counted LEAD pipelines only (cma.counted_deals_of: coalesce(is_counted,true) and coalesce(is_lead,true)), never an order pipeline (not coalesce(is_order,false)); not deleted; created on or after intake.start_date
period: the deal's creation business date (tenant zone) between from and to, at most 92 days (cma.report_range)

attempt window: calls from creation - speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes to the earliest of the close (won or lost), the contacts' first order (a won order deal at its close or a store order at its creation; no day cap) and now; a call after that is never an attempt (Decision log, 20 Oct 2026)

attempt (attempts.source=telephony, the default): an outbound telephony call, not deleted, with a start, on a counted line (a line not yet in the catalog counts), currently linked (call_link, unlinked_at null) to a not-deleted CRM call associated with the deal or its contacts; attempts.source=crm: every outbound CRM call of the deal/contacts. A call to a contact with two open deals counts for both deals

page filters, all applied to current AND previous alike: market (code or unknown), pipeline (connection:pipeline), attempted (all/none/some), outcome (all/open/won/lost/ordered); an invalid filter value is dropped with a notice (web) / 400 (API)
