entries.verify_sql:
with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'attempts.source') as src,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cmin,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vmin,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d0 as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, r.stage_id,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as business_date,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null
          union
          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d0.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)
               or exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = od.connection_id
                          and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = od.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null
                          and a2.to_id = any(dk.contacts)))),
      (select min(co.source_created_at) from cma.crm_contact k
        join cma.crm_contact_ref cr on cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.contact_id = k.id
        join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.source_system = cr.system and co.customer_source_id = cr.external_id
        where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.connection_id = dk.connection_id and k.source_id = any(dk.contacts)
          and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
          and co.source_created_at >= dk.created_at and co.source_created_at <= now())) as ordered_at,
    st.outcome as stage_outcome, st.label as stage_label
  from dk
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = dk.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = dk.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = dk.stage_id),
w as (
  select w0.*, least(coalesce(w0.closed_end,'infinity'), coalesce(w0.ordered_at,'infinity'), now()) as window_end,
    case when w0.closed_end is not null and (w0.ordered_at is null or w0.closed_end <= w0.ordered_at) then 'closed'
         when w0.ordered_at is not null then 'ordered' else 'open' end as end_reason
  from w0),
wd as (
  select w.*, case when w.stage_outcome = 'won' then 'won' when w.end_reason = 'ordered' then 'ordered'
                   when w.stage_outcome = 'lost' then 'lost' when w.is_closed then 'unknown' else 'open' end as outcome
  from w),
ca as (
  select wd.deal_id, cc.id as call_id, coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) as eff_at,
         tc.started_at is not null as linked, cc.direction as cdir, tc.direction as tdir,
         coalesce(n.is_counted, true) as line_counted, cc.outcome_ref,
         tc.talk_seconds,
         coalesce(tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s)), false) as connected,
         co.label as outcome_label,
         case when (select src from s) = 'crm' then cc.direction = 'outbound'
              else tc.started_at is not null and tc.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) end as is_attempt,
         cc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.started_at is null as without_aircall,
         coalesce(((tc.direction = 'outbound' and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s))) or tc.direction = 'inbound')
                  and tc.answered_at is not null and tc.talk_seconds >= (select vmin from s), false)
           and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref
                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref
  left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = :tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) >= wd.created_at - make_interval(mins => (select pre_min from s))
    and coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) <= wd.window_end
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id
                and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = cc.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),
f as (
  select wd.*, a.attempts, a.conversations, a.first_conversation, a.talk_total, a.talk_conversation, a.first_at, a.last_at, a.no_outcome, a.without_aircall,
         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,
           (min(rn) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation))::int as first_conversation,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,
           min(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as first_at,
           max(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as last_at,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.outcome_ref is null)::int as no_outcome,
           count(*) filter (where ca.without_aircall)::int as without_aircall
    from (select ca.*, row_number() over (partition by ca.is_attempt order by ca.eff_at, ca.call_id) as rn
          from ca where ca.deal_id = wd.deal_id) ca(deal_id, call_id, eff_at, linked, cdir, tdir, line_counted, outcome_ref,
                                                    talk_seconds, connected, outcome_label, is_attempt, without_aircall, conversation, rn)
    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)
select xo.user_id, count(*) filter (where f.outcome='open' and f.attempts=0) as open_never
from f
left join cma.app_user_external_id xo on xo.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xo.system = 'hubspot_owner' and xo.external_id = f.owner_ref
group by xo.user_id order by xo.user_id

with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'attempts.source') as src,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cmin,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vmin,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d0 as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, r.stage_id,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as business_date,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null
          union
          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d0.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)
               or exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = od.connection_id
                          and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = od.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null
                          and a2.to_id = any(dk.contacts)))),
      (select min(co.source_created_at) from cma.crm_contact k
        join cma.crm_contact_ref cr on cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.contact_id = k.id
        join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.source_system = cr.system and co.customer_source_id = cr.external_id
        where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.connection_id = dk.connection_id and k.source_id = any(dk.contacts)
          and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
          and co.source_created_at >= dk.created_at and co.source_created_at <= now())) as ordered_at,
    st.outcome as stage_outcome, st.label as stage_label
  from dk
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = dk.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = dk.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = dk.stage_id),
w as (
  select w0.*, least(coalesce(w0.closed_end,'infinity'), coalesce(w0.ordered_at,'infinity'), now()) as window_end,
    case when w0.closed_end is not null and (w0.ordered_at is null or w0.closed_end <= w0.ordered_at) then 'closed'
         when w0.ordered_at is not null then 'ordered' else 'open' end as end_reason
  from w0),
wd as (
  select w.*, case when w.stage_outcome = 'won' then 'won' when w.end_reason = 'ordered' then 'ordered'
                   when w.stage_outcome = 'lost' then 'lost' when w.is_closed then 'unknown' else 'open' end as outcome
  from w),
ca as (
  select wd.deal_id, cc.id as call_id, coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) as eff_at,
         tc.started_at is not null as linked, cc.direction as cdir, tc.direction as tdir,
         coalesce(n.is_counted, true) as line_counted, cc.outcome_ref,
         tc.talk_seconds,
         coalesce(tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s)), false) as connected,
         co.label as outcome_label,
         case when (select src from s) = 'crm' then cc.direction = 'outbound'
              else tc.started_at is not null and tc.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) end as is_attempt,
         cc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.started_at is null as without_aircall,
         coalesce(((tc.direction = 'outbound' and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s))) or tc.direction = 'inbound')
                  and tc.answered_at is not null and tc.talk_seconds >= (select vmin from s), false)
           and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref
                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref
  left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = :tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) >= wd.created_at - make_interval(mins => (select pre_min from s))
    and coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) <= wd.window_end
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id
                and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = cc.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),
f as (
  select wd.*, a.attempts, a.conversations, a.first_conversation, a.talk_total, a.talk_conversation, a.first_at, a.last_at, a.no_outcome, a.without_aircall,
         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,
           (min(rn) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation))::int as first_conversation,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,
           min(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as first_at,
           max(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as last_at,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.outcome_ref is null)::int as no_outcome,
           count(*) filter (where ca.without_aircall)::int as without_aircall
    from (select ca.*, row_number() over (partition by ca.is_attempt order by ca.eff_at, ca.call_id) as rn
          from ca where ca.deal_id = wd.deal_id) ca(deal_id, call_id, eff_at, linked, cdir, tdir, line_counted, outcome_ref,
                                                    talk_seconds, connected, outcome_label, is_attempt, without_aircall, conversation, rn)
    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)
select count(distinct f.owner_ref) as unlinked_owners, count(*) as deals
from f
left join cma.app_user_external_id xo on xo.tenant_id = :tenant_id and xo.system = 'hubspot_owner' and xo.external_id = f.owner_ref
left join cma.app_user u on u.tenant_id = :tenant_id and u.id = xo.user_id
where u.id is null

with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, coalesce(p.label, r.pipeline_id) as pipeline_label,
         r.stage_id, r.reason, r.source_channel, r.amount, coalesce(r.currency, mk.currency) as currency, r.owner_ref,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as created_date,
         (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::time as created_time,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at,
         (r.closed_at at time zone t.zone)::date as closed_date, (r.closed_at at time zone t.zone)::time as closed_time,
         case when coalesce(r.is_closed,false) then st.outcome end as stage_outcome,
         coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, r.market),
                  cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
                    where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = r.connection_id and cc.source_id = r.contact_source_id)),
                  'unknown') as market
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id
  left join cma.market mk on mk.tenant_id = :tenant_id
       and mk.code = coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, r.market), 'unknown')
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone))
select d.owner_ref, count(*) filter (where d.stage_outcome='won') as won from d where d.stage_outcome in ('won','lost') and d.closed_date between :from and :to group by 1 order by 1

      where rk.tenant_id = :tenant_id and rk.key = cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'reports.cancellation_kind') and rk.status = 'active'),
r as (
  select rec.id as record_id, rec.connection_id, rec.source_id, rec.pipeline_id, rec.reason,
         coalesce(rec.is_closed,false) as is_closed, rec.source_created_at as created_at, rec.closed_at,
         (rec.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as created_date,
         coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, rec.market),

entries.time: Dates are calendar dates as the register holds them. Today and the current month are the tenant's (cma.tenant_today_of, the tenant's zone). The horizon starts on the first day of the current month or a later one and runs 6, 12 or 24 months (the API takes 1 to 24).

entries.verify_sql:
with t as (select (now() at time zone timezone)::date as today from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
d as (select dv.id, dv.market, dv.model_key, dv.end_of_life_on, coalesce(dv.last_shipped_on, dv.first_shipped_on) as anchor
      from cma.device dv join cma.device_status st on st.tenant_id = dv.tenant_id and st.key = dv.device_status_key and st.is_tracked
      where dv.tenant_id = :tenant_id and dv.source_deleted_at is null),
i as (select d.id, k.key as component, coalesce(c.expires_on, (a.anchor + make_interval(months => r.interval_months))::date) - coalesce(r.lead_days, 0) as action_on
      from d join cma.device_component_kind k on k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.status = 'active'
      left join cma.device_component c on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.device_id = d.id and c.component_key = k.key and c.replaced_at is null
      left join cma.maintenance_rule r on r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.model_key = d.model_key and r.component_key = k.key
      cross join lateral (select case when c.id is not null and exists (select 1 from cma.device_component p where p.tenant_id = :tenant_id
                                       and p.device_id = d.id and p.component_key = k.key and p.replaced_at is not null)
                                      then (c.first_seen_at at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id))::date
                                      else d.anchor end as anchor) a
      where c.id is not null or r.id is not null or d.model_key is null
      union all select d.id, 'device', d.end_of_life_on from d where d.end_of_life_on is not null)
select coalesce(d.market, 'unknown') as market, coalesce(d.model_key, 'unknown') as model, count(*) as past_due_items
from i join d on d.id = i.id cross join t
where i.action_on < date_trunc('month', t.today)
group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

population: devices whose device status has is_tracked and that the latest full snapshot still holds (source_deleted_at is null); never a status name
scope filter: field (is_in_field), stock (is_in_stock) or every tracked device; market (a code or unknown) and model (a key or unknown) filters on the device's mapped values
entries.time: Dates are calendar dates as the register holds them. Today and the current month are the tenant's (cma.tenant_today_of, the tenant's zone). The horizon starts on the first day of the current month or a later one and runs 6, 12 or 24 months (the API takes 1 to 24).

entries.verify_sql:
with t as (select (now() at time zone timezone)::date as today from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
d as (select dv.id, dv.market, dv.model_key, dv.end_of_life_on, coalesce(dv.last_shipped_on, dv.first_shipped_on) as anchor
      from cma.device dv join cma.device_status st on st.tenant_id = dv.tenant_id and st.key = dv.device_status_key and st.is_tracked
      where dv.tenant_id = :tenant_id and dv.source_deleted_at is null),
i as (select d.id, k.key as component, coalesce(c.expires_on, (a.anchor + make_interval(months => r.interval_months))::date) - coalesce(r.lead_days, 0) as action_on
      from d join cma.device_component_kind k on k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.status = 'active'
      left join cma.device_component c on c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.device_id = d.id and c.component_key = k.key and c.replaced_at is null
      left join cma.maintenance_rule r on r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.model_key = d.model_key and r.component_key = k.key
      cross join lateral (select case when c.id is not null and exists (select 1 from cma.device_component p where p.tenant_id = :tenant_id
                                       and p.device_id = d.id and p.component_key = k.key and p.replaced_at is not null)
                                      then (c.first_seen_at at time zone (select timezone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id))::date
                                      else d.anchor end as anchor) a
      where c.id is not null or r.id is not null or d.model_key is null
      union all select d.id, 'device', d.end_of_life_on from d where d.end_of_life_on is not null)
select date_trunc('month', i.action_on)::date as month, i.component, count(*) as items
from i where i.action_on >= :from and i.action_on < :to
group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

filters: tenant: RLS (row-level security on tenant_id) plus the explicit tenant in every cma.*_of read
every stored submission of every form: polled or not, counted in Intake or not, lead condition ignored (the report counts submissions, not leads)
period on the business date in the submission's market zone (p_until cuts the previous span's last date at now's time of day)
market filter: a code or 'unknown'; category filter: a code or 'none' (forms without one); form filter: connection_id ':' form_id; invalid values dropped with a notice (parseFormsFilter)
no intake.start_date bound and no counted/uncounted narrowing — unlike Intake's form count
entries.time: Business date = submitted_at in the submission's market zone (cma.market.time_zone), else the tenant's zone; ISO week = its Monday (date_trunc('week')); now = now() at read time; the read takes a day's margin each side so a market in another zone keeps its whole dates
entries.comparison: Previous span like for like (cma.forms_previous_of, as 0008j): as many dates before `from` as the period holds; a period that reaches today compares the same elapsed dates, the last cut at now's time of day in each submission's own zone (until); 'No history' (changeNoHistory) when the previous span starts before cma.forms_history_start() (web previousBeforeHistory)
entries.refresh: on page load (server-rendered; no poll on the report pages)
entries.verify_sql:
with s as (select timezone as tz from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
x as (
  select fs.id, fs.connection_id, fs.source_form_id, fs.submitted_at, fs.contact_resolution, fs.kept_values,
         f.name as form_name, f.category,
         coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, f.market),
                  case when f.market_field is not null and jsonb_typeof(fs.kept_values -> f.market_field) = 'string'
                       then cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, fs.kept_values ->> f.market_field) end,
                  (select cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, cc.country) from cma.crm_contact cc
                    where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = fs.connection_id and cc.source_id = fs.contact_source_id),
                  'unknown') as market
  from cma.form_submission fs
  join cma.connection_form f on f.tenant_id = fs.tenant_id and f.connection_id = fs.connection_id and f.source_form_id = fs.source_form_id
  where fs.tenant_id = :tenant_id
),
d as (
  select x.*, (x.submitted_at at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = x.market), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from x cross join s
)

entries.definition: New customers' first orders: won deals in the order pipeline whose contact has no earlier won order deal and whose linked store order is no renewal and counts no earlier orders.
entries.formula: first_orders = count(order deals with kind = 'first'); an order deal = a deal, not deleted, in a counted pipeline marked is_order whose stage outcome is won, T = source_created_at; kind: no_contact (no primary contact and no current contact association) → renewal (linked order's order_kind = 'renewal') → repeat (an earlier won order deal of the same contact, primary or current association, earlier by (source_created_at, id)) → not_first (linked order's order_kind = 'repeat') → else first; the linked order = nearest store order of the contact's matched customer within attribution.order_match_minutes of T (not test/cancelled/deleted); delta vs the previous span like for like; also the 'First orders' column of the per-group/per-market tables and the per-level bars

entries.verify_sql:
with s as (select t.timezone as tz,
         make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.order_match_minutes')::integer) as match
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select r.id, r.connection_id, r.source_created_at as t, r.market as own_market, r.amount as deal_amount, r.currency as deal_currency,
         coalesce(r.contact_source_id,
                  (select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                   where a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and a.connection_id = r.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
                     and a.from_id = r.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null
                   order by a.first_seen_at, a.to_id limit 1)) as contact
  from cma.crm_record r
  join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted
  join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won'
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
),
o as (
  select d.*,
    (select co.order_kind from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_kind,
    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_amount,
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm
)
select count(*) from k where k.business_date between :from and :to and k.kind = 'first'

entries.notes: Tile detail counts the four kinds apart: '{repeats} repeat, {renewals} renewals, {notFirst} not first and {noContact} without a contact counted apart' — those have entries of their own. A tenant without a counted order pipeline sees 'No orders connected' (cma.first_orders_connected_of), never 0. attribution.order_match_minutes decides the linked order (both directions around T, nearest by |Δt| then time then id). The five attribution settings are proposed defaults Kira has not confirmed (open-decisions.md, Indirect sales; kpis.md §2), so the figure's meaning is provisional: status ambiguous. Cross-page: Reports → Intake's 'First orders' counts store orders by commerce_order.order_kind='first' per store market — same words, different figure (see finding).

entries.definition: First orders with evidence the call center counts in the window before the order.
entries.formula: call_center = count(kind = 'first' and attribution = 'call_center'); attribution = 'call_center' when the level (the first evidence in attribution.level_order that holds) is in attribution.assisted_levels, else 'self_service'; evidence each in [T − attribution.window_days, T): lead_deal (a deal of the contact in a counted lead pipeline that is no order pipeline), conversation (an associated CRM call whose linked telephony call is a Conversation, cma.is_conversation: a connected outbound or an answered inbound call with at least calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds of talk and no current tag meaning not reached or incorrect data; at that telephony call's start), email (an agent's email out, sent, to the contact: inbox message not of bot/ai/system/integration and not spam, or an engagement that is neither an inbox copy nor an automation by origin), phone_match (any call, CRM or telephony, whose counterpart hash equals the linked order's or its customer's phone hash), attempt (an associated CRM call whose linked telephony call is outbound, a conversation included; a CRM call without a current link, an inbound call that is no conversation and a CRM call's outcome are no evidence); known_contact = the contact's source_created_at ≤ T − attribution.known_contact_minutes; share detail = call_center / first_orders (dash at 0)

entries.verify_sql:
with s as (select t.timezone as tz,
         make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.order_match_minutes')::integer) as match
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select r.id, r.connection_id, r.source_created_at as t, r.market as own_market, r.amount as deal_amount, r.currency as deal_currency,
         coalesce(r.contact_source_id,
                  (select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                   where a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and a.connection_id = r.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
                     and a.from_id = r.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null
                   order by a.first_seen_at, a.to_id limit 1)) as contact
  from cma.crm_record r
  join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted
  join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won'
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
),
o as (
  select d.*,
    (select co.order_kind from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_kind,
    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact

with s as (select t.timezone as tz,
         make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.order_match_minutes')::integer) as match
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select r.id, r.connection_id, r.source_created_at as t, r.market as own_market, r.amount as deal_amount, r.currency as deal_currency,
         coalesce(r.contact_source_id,
                  (select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                   where a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and a.connection_id = r.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
                     and a.from_id = r.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null
                   order by a.first_seen_at, a.to_id limit 1)) as contact
  from cma.crm_record r
  join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted
  join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won'
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
),
o as (
  select d.*,
    (select co.order_kind from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_kind,
    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_amount,
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm

    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu

      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null

with s as (
  select t.timezone as zone, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id, 'intake.start_date')::date as start_date
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select d.connection_id, d.source_id, d.contact_source_id,
         exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a
                 where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d.connection_id
                   and a.from_type = 'deal' and a.from_id = d.source_id
                   and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) as has_assoc
  from cma.crm_record d cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p
    on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = d.connection_id
   and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id
  where d.tenant_id = :tenant_id and d.record_type = 'deal' and d.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true)
    and d.source_created_at >= (s.start_date::timestamp at time zone s.zone))
select count(*) from d where d.contact_source_id is null and not d.has_assoc

entries.definition: How long one trivial database read takes from the application, as a liveness and latency signal for the storage; shown as a Fast/Slow/No answer badge with the milliseconds next to it.
entries.formula: roundTripMs = round(performance.now() after - before) around one whole transaction: pool checkout, begin, set tenant context, select cma.assert_permission('tenant.configure'), select 1, commit (postgres.ts probeDatabase, line 2821). State: fast when roundTripMs <= 200, slow when > 200, down when the transaction failed (roundTripMs null; a CMA06/CMA01 permission error is rethrown, never shown as down) (lib/health.ts probeState, line 132).

entries.notes: verify_sql null: the figure is a timing measured by the application, not derivable from any table. Unit: the schema's enum has no milliseconds; recorded as seconds with the value displayed in ms. The 200 ms fast/slow threshold is hardcoded in lib/health.ts (and named in the hint copy probeHint), not a tenant setting; see finding on hardcoded thresholds. Down shows the badge 'No answer' with no number. The timing includes the pool checkout, so a cold pool reads slower than the database alone.

entries.definition: How long ago the ingest sweep last ran for this tenant (the sweep leaves one link_calls run per tenant per minute), as the one signal that the ingest jobs run at all: Fresh, Late, Silent or No run yet, with 'Last run {age} ago'.
entries.formula: age = max(0, floor((now_ms - parse(lastStartedAt of the newest sync_run row with job = 'link_calls' among the cma.system_health_runs() rows)) / 1000)) (lib/health.ts heartbeatRun + ageSeconds). entries.definition: The running clock: time worked today in working statuses, ticking every second, pausing on non-working statuses and stopping at the day's window end.

with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
k as (select rk.key, rk.record_type from cma.record_kind rk
      where rk.tenant_id = :tenant_id and rk.key = cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'reports.cancellation_kind') and rk.status = 'active'),
r as (
  select rec.id as record_id, rec.connection_id, rec.source_id, rec.pipeline_id, rec.reason,
         coalesce(rec.is_closed,false) as is_closed, rec.source_created_at as created_at, rec.closed_at,
         (rec.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as created_date,
         coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, rec.market),
                  cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
                    where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = rec.connection_id and cc.source_id = rec.contact_source_id)),
                  'unknown') as market,
         case when coalesce(rec.is_closed,false) and rec.closed_at is not null
              then round((extract(epoch from rec.closed_at - rec.source_created_at) / 86400.0)::numeric, 2) end as days_to_close
  from cma.crm_record rec cross join t cross join s join k on rec.record_type = k.record_type
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = rec.connection_id
       and p.record_type = rec.record_type and p.source_pipeline_id = rec.pipeline_id
  where rec.tenant_id = :tenant_id and rec.source_deleted_at is null and coalesce(p.is_counted, true)
    and rec.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (rec.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to
    and exists (select 1 from cma.connection_record_kind cr
                where cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.kind_key = k.key and cr.status = 'active' and cr.connection_id = rec.connection_id
                  and (cr.pipeline_id is not null or cr.category is not null)
                  and (cr.pipeline_id is null or cr.pipeline_id = rec.pipeline_id)
                  and (cr.category is null or cr.category = rec.category)))
select date_trunc('week', r.created_date)::date as week, r.market, count(*) as requests from r group by 1,2 order by 1,2

entries.verify_sql:
with s as (select t.timezone as tz,
         make_interval(mins => cma.setting_of(t.id, 'attribution.order_match_minutes')::integer) as match
  from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id),
d as (
  select r.id, r.connection_id, r.source_created_at as t, r.market as own_market, r.amount as deal_amount, r.currency as deal_currency,
         coalesce(r.contact_source_id,
                  (select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
                   where a.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and a.connection_id = r.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
                     and a.from_id = r.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null
                   order by a.first_seen_at, a.to_id limit 1)) as contact
  from cma.crm_record r
  join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and p.is_order and p.is_counted
  join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
    and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id and st.outcome = 'won'
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
),
o as (
  select d.*,
    (select co.order_kind from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_kind,
    (select co.total_amount from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_amount,
    (select co.currency from cma.commerce_customer cu
      join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = cu.tenant_id and co.connection_id = cu.connection_id and co.customer_source_id = cu.source_id
      where cu.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cu.crm_connection_id = d.connection_id and cu.crm_contact_source_id = d.contact
        and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
        and co.source_created_at between d.t - s.match and d.t + s.match
      order by abs(extract(epoch from co.source_created_at - d.t)), co.source_created_at, co.id limit 1) as linked_currency
  from d cross join s
),
k as (
  select o.*, rm.code as market,
    case when o.contact is null then 'no_contact'
         when o.linked_kind = 'renewal' then 'renewal'
         when exists (
           select 1 from cma.crm_record r2
           join cma.connection_pipeline p2 on p2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and p2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and p2.record_type = 'deal' and p2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and p2.is_order and p2.is_counted
           join cma.connection_stage st2 on st2.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id and st2.connection_id = r2.connection_id
             and st2.record_type = 'deal' and st2.source_pipeline_id = r2.pipeline_id and st2.source_stage_id = r2.stage_id and st2.outcome = 'won'
           where r2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r2.connection_id = o.connection_id and r2.record_type = 'deal' and r2.source_deleted_at is null
             and (r2.contact_source_id = o.contact
                  or (r2.contact_source_id is distinct from o.contact and exists (
                        select 1 from cma.crm_association a2
                        where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = o.connection_id and a2.from_type = 'deal'
                          and a2.from_id = r2.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.to_id = o.contact and a2.removed_at is null)))
             and (r2.source_created_at < o.t or (r2.source_created_at = o.t and r2.id < o.id))) then 'repeat'
         when o.linked_kind = 'repeat' then 'not_first'
         else 'first' end as kind,
    (o.t at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = rm.code), s.tz))::date as business_date
  from o cross join s
  cross join lateral cma.record_market_of(:tenant_id, o.connection_id, o.own_market, o.contact) rm
)
select k.id, case when k.linked_kind is not null then k.linked_currency else k.deal_currency end, case when k.linked_kind is not null then k.linked_amount else k.deal_amount end from k where k.business_date between :from and :to and k.kind = 'first'

entries.verify_sql:
with s as (select timezone as tz from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
x as (
  select fs.id, fs.connection_id, fs.source_form_id, fs.submitted_at, fs.contact_resolution, fs.kept_values,
         f.name as form_name, f.category,
         coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, f.market),
                  case when f.market_field is not null and jsonb_typeof(fs.kept_values -> f.market_field) = 'string'
                       then cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, fs.kept_values ->> f.market_field) end,
                  (select cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, cc.country) from cma.crm_contact cc
                    where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = fs.connection_id and cc.source_id = fs.contact_source_id),
                  'unknown') as market
  from cma.form_submission fs
  join cma.connection_form f on f.tenant_id = fs.tenant_id and f.connection_id = fs.connection_id and f.source_form_id = fs.source_form_id
  where fs.tenant_id = :tenant_id
),
d as (
  select x.*, (x.submitted_at at time zone coalesce((select m.time_zone from cma.market m where m.tenant_id = :tenant_id and m.code = x.market), s.tz))::date as business_date

entries.verify_sql:
with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, coalesce(p.label, r.pipeline_id) as pipeline_label,
         r.stage_id, r.reason, r.source_channel, r.amount, coalesce(r.currency, mk.currency) as currency, r.owner_ref,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as created_date,
         (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::time as created_time,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at,
         (r.closed_at at time zone t.zone)::date as closed_date, (r.closed_at at time zone t.zone)::time as closed_time,
         case when coalesce(r.is_closed,false) then st.outcome end as stage_outcome,
         coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, r.market),
                  cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
                    where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = r.connection_id and cc.source_id = r.contact_source_id)),
                  'unknown') as market
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id
  left join cma.market mk on mk.tenant_id = :tenant_id
       and mk.code = coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, r.market), 'unknown')
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone))
select d.reason, round(count(*)::numeric / nullif(sum(count(*)) over (),0),4) as share_of_all from d where d.stage_outcome = 'lost' and d.closed_date between :from and :to group by 1

with win as (select coalesce(ts.value, s.default_value)::time as w_end from cma.setting s left join cma.tenant_setting ts on ts.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ts.key = s.key where s.key = 'workday.window_end'),
eff as (select e.id, e.workday_id, e.kind, e.status_id, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at from cma.time_event e where e.tenant_id = :tenant_id and e.kind in ('start','status','end') and not exists (select 1 from cma.time_event c where c.tenant_id = :tenant_id and c.supersedes_event_id = e.id)),

from iv join cma.work_status ws on ws.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ws.id = iv.status_id where iv.kind in ('start','status') group by iv.user_id, iv.business_date order by iv.business_date, iv.user_id

with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'speed_to_lead.pre_window_minutes')::integer) as pre_min,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'attempts.source') as src,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'telephony.connected_min_seconds')::integer) as cmin,
             greatest(0, cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'calls.conversation_min_talk_seconds')::integer) as vmin,
             cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d0 as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, r.stage_id,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as business_date,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at, r.market as raw_market, r.contact_source_id, r.owner_ref
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone)
    and (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date between :from and :to),
dk as (
  select d0.*,
    array(select x from (select d0.contact_source_id as x where d0.contact_source_id is not null
          union
          select a.to_id from cma.crm_association a
          where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = d0.connection_id and a.from_type = 'deal'
            and a.from_id = d0.source_id and a.to_type = 'contact' and a.removed_at is null) c order by x) as contacts,
    coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, d0.raw_market),
             cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
               where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = d0.connection_id and cc.source_id = d0.contact_source_id)),
             'unknown') as market
  from d0),
w0 as (
  select dk.*,
    case when dk.is_closed then least(coalesce(dk.closed_at, now()), now()) end as closed_end,
    least(
      (select min(coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at)) from cma.crm_record od
        join cma.connection_pipeline op on op.tenant_id = :tenant_id and op.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and op.record_type = 'deal' and op.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and coalesce(op.is_order,false) and coalesce(op.is_counted,true)
        join cma.connection_stage os on os.tenant_id = :tenant_id and os.connection_id = od.connection_id
             and os.record_type = 'deal' and os.source_pipeline_id = od.pipeline_id and os.source_stage_id = od.stage_id and os.outcome = 'won'
        where od.tenant_id = :tenant_id and od.record_type = 'deal' and od.source_deleted_at is null
          and od.connection_id = dk.connection_id and od.source_created_at >= dk.created_at
          and coalesce(od.closed_at, od.source_created_at) <= now()
          and (od.contact_source_id = any(dk.contacts)
               or exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a2 where a2.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a2.connection_id = od.connection_id
                          and a2.from_type = 'deal' and a2.from_id = od.source_id and a2.to_type = 'contact' and a2.removed_at is null
                          and a2.to_id = any(dk.contacts)))),
      (select min(co.source_created_at) from cma.crm_contact k
        join cma.crm_contact_ref cr on cr.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cr.contact_id = k.id
        join cma.commerce_order co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.source_system = cr.system and co.customer_source_id = cr.external_id
        where k.tenant_id = :tenant_id and k.connection_id = dk.connection_id and k.source_id = any(dk.contacts)
          and not co.is_test and co.cancelled_at is null and co.source_deleted_at is null
          and co.source_created_at >= dk.created_at and co.source_created_at <= now())) as ordered_at,
    st.outcome as stage_outcome, st.label as stage_label
  from dk
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = dk.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = dk.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = dk.stage_id),
w as (
  select w0.*, least(coalesce(w0.closed_end,'infinity'), coalesce(w0.ordered_at,'infinity'), now()) as window_end,
    case when w0.closed_end is not null and (w0.ordered_at is null or w0.closed_end <= w0.ordered_at) then 'closed'
         when w0.ordered_at is not null then 'ordered' else 'open' end as end_reason
  from w0),
wd as (
  select w.*, case when w.stage_outcome = 'won' then 'won' when w.end_reason = 'ordered' then 'ordered'
                   when w.stage_outcome = 'lost' then 'lost' when w.is_closed then 'unknown' else 'open' end as outcome
  from w),
ca as (
  select wd.deal_id, cc.id as call_id, coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) as eff_at,
         tc.started_at is not null as linked, cc.direction as cdir, tc.direction as tdir,
         coalesce(n.is_counted, true) as line_counted, cc.outcome_ref,
         tc.talk_seconds,
         coalesce(tc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.answered_at is not null and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s)), false) as connected,
         co.label as outcome_label,
         case when (select src from s) = 'crm' then cc.direction = 'outbound'
              else tc.started_at is not null and tc.direction = 'outbound' and coalesce(n.is_counted, true) end as is_attempt,
         cc.direction = 'outbound' and tc.started_at is null as without_aircall,
         coalesce(((tc.direction = 'outbound' and ((select cmin from s) = 0 or tc.talk_seconds >= (select cmin from s))) or tc.direction = 'inbound')
                  and tc.answered_at is not null and tc.talk_seconds >= (select vmin from s), false)
           and not exists (select 1 from cma.telephony_call_tag ct join cma.telephony_tag tg on tg.tenant_id = ct.tenant_id and tg.connection_id = ct.connection_id and tg.tag_ref = ct.tag_ref
                           where ct.tenant_id = :tenant_id and ct.connection_id = tc.connection_id and ct.call_source_id = tc.source_id
                             and ct.untagged_at is null and tg.meaning in ('not_reached', 'incorrect_data')) as conversation
  from wd
  join cma.crm_call cc on cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = wd.connection_id and cc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.call_link l on l.tenant_id = :tenant_id and l.crm_call_id = cc.id and l.unlinked_at is null
  left join cma.telephony_call tc on tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.id = l.telephony_call_id and tc.source_deleted_at is null
  left join cma.connection_call_outcome co on co.tenant_id = :tenant_id and co.connection_id = cc.connection_id and co.outcome_ref = cc.outcome_ref
  left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = :tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref
  where coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) >= wd.created_at - make_interval(mins => (select pre_min from s))
    and coalesce(tc.started_at, cc.occurred_at) <= wd.window_end
    and exists (select 1 from cma.crm_association a where a.tenant_id = :tenant_id and a.connection_id = wd.connection_id
                and a.from_type = 'crm_call' and a.from_id = cc.source_id and a.removed_at is null
                and ((a.to_type = 'deal' and a.to_id = wd.source_id) or (a.to_type = 'contact' and a.to_id = any(wd.contacts))))),
f as (
  select wd.*, a.attempts, a.conversations, a.first_conversation, a.talk_total, a.talk_conversation, a.first_at, a.last_at, a.no_outcome, a.without_aircall,
         case when a.first_at is not null then cma.business_seconds_of(:tenant_id, nullif(wd.market,'unknown'), wd.created_at, a.first_at) end as speed_s
  from wd
  left join lateral (
    select count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt)::int as attempts,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation)::int as conversations,
           (min(rn) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation))::int as first_conversation,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt), 0)::int as talk_total,
           coalesce(sum(ca.talk_seconds) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.conversation), 0)::int as talk_conversation,
           min(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as first_at,
           max(ca.eff_at) filter (where ca.is_attempt) as last_at,
           count(*) filter (where ca.is_attempt and ca.outcome_ref is null)::int as no_outcome,
           count(*) filter (where ca.without_aircall)::int as without_aircall
    from (select ca.*, row_number() over (partition by ca.is_attempt order by ca.eff_at, ca.call_id) as rn
          from ca where ca.deal_id = wd.deal_id) ca(deal_id, call_id, eff_at, linked, cdir, tdir, line_counted, outcome_ref,
                                                    talk_seconds, connected, outcome_label, is_attempt, without_aircall, conversation, rn)
    where ca.is_attempt or ca.without_aircall) a on true)
select coalesce(sum(f.talk_total),0) as talk_seconds_total, coalesce(sum(f.conversations),0) as conversation_attempts, count(f.speed_s) as speed_deals from f

with t as (select timezone as zone from cma.tenant where id = :tenant_id),
s as (select cma.setting_of(:tenant_id,'intake.start_date')::date as sd),
d as (
  select r.id as deal_id, r.connection_id, r.source_id, r.pipeline_id, coalesce(p.label, r.pipeline_id) as pipeline_label,
         r.stage_id, r.reason, r.source_channel, r.amount, coalesce(r.currency, mk.currency) as currency, r.owner_ref,
         r.source_created_at as created_at, (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::date as created_date,
         (r.source_created_at at time zone t.zone)::time as created_time,
         coalesce(r.is_closed,false) as is_closed, r.closed_at,
         (r.closed_at at time zone t.zone)::date as closed_date, (r.closed_at at time zone t.zone)::time as closed_time,
         case when coalesce(r.is_closed,false) then st.outcome end as stage_outcome,
         coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, r.market),
                  cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, (select cc.country from cma.crm_contact cc
                    where cc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and cc.connection_id = r.connection_id and cc.source_id = r.contact_source_id)),
                  'unknown') as market
  from cma.crm_record r cross join t cross join s
  left join cma.connection_pipeline p on p.tenant_id = :tenant_id and p.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and p.record_type = 'deal' and p.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id
  left join cma.connection_stage st on st.tenant_id = :tenant_id and st.connection_id = r.connection_id
       and st.record_type = 'deal' and st.source_pipeline_id = r.pipeline_id and st.source_stage_id = r.stage_id
  left join cma.market mk on mk.tenant_id = :tenant_id
       and mk.code = coalesce(cma.market_code_of(:tenant_id, r.market), 'unknown')
  where r.tenant_id = :tenant_id and r.record_type = 'deal' and r.source_deleted_at is null
    and coalesce(p.is_counted, true) and coalesce(p.is_lead, true) and not coalesce(p.is_order, false)
    and r.source_created_at >= (s.sd::timestamp at time zone t.zone))
, e as (
  select rs.connection_id, rs.source_stage_id as stage_id, rs.entered_at, rs.exited_at,
         (rs.entered_at at time zone (select zone from t))::date as entered_date,
         d.stage_id as current_stage_id, d.stage_outcome
  from cma.crm_record_stage rs
  join d on d.connection_id = rs.connection_id and d.source_id = rs.source_id

entries.time: Today = calls started in [tenant midnight, next midnight) in the tenant's zone (cma.inbound_today_of); waiting is relative to the database's now(); the business date each call would get on the report is its line's market zone instead (cross-page note)
entries.refresh: computed on request
entries.verify_sql: with s as (select t.timezone as tz, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.service_level_seconds'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.service_level_seconds'))::int) as sl, greatest(0, coalesce((select value from cma.tenant_setting x where x.tenant_id = :tenant_id and x.key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'), (select default_value from cma.setting where key = 'telephony.waiting_max_minutes'))::int) as wm from cma.tenant t where t.id = :tenant_id), c as (select tc.answered_at, tc.source_system, greatest(0, extract(epoch from tc.answered_at - tc.started_at)) as answer_s, (tc.answered_at is null and tc.ended_at is null and tc.started_at >= now() - make_interval(mins => s.wm)) as waiting, coalesce(nullif(btrim(tc.missed_reason), ''), 'unknown') as code, (tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::date as bdate, extract(hour from tc.started_at at time zone coalesce(m.time_zone, s.tz))::int as bhour, tc.started_at, s.sl, s.wm, s.tz from cma.telephony_call tc cross join s left join cma.telephony_number n on n.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and n.connection_id = tc.connection_id and n.number_ref = tc.number_ref left join cma.market m on m.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id and m.code = n.market where tc.tenant_id = :tenant_id and tc.direction = 'inbound' and tc.source_deleted_at is null and tc.started_at is not null and coalesce(n.is_counted, true)) select count(*) filter (where c.waiting) as waiting from c where c.started_at >= (now() at time zone c.tz)::date::timestamp at time zone c.tz and c.started_at < ((now() at time zone c.tz)::date + 1)::timestamp at time zone c.tz
